title: Phoebe, the Lambent Lady
summary: The Incarna of Luna who lights the Aetherial Realm.

claims.text: Phoebe, also called Sokhta, is an Incarna of Luna and patron of the Stargazers, who call Phoebe the Lambent Lady; this Incarna fills half the sky of the Aetherial Realm.
Garou build moon bridges and moon paths from that silvery light; Phoebe may appear as a human, a cat, a wolf or a sphere of moonsilver.
Phoebe is said to be Luna's daughter, and many Stargazers believe Incarnae are facets of their Celestines in forms mortal minds can bear.
Phoebe's roads are clearest and safest at the full moon, though the Incarna is then at its most warlike.
Zarok, the Crowned Ruler, dwells in Jupiter and reigns over the Umbral solar system; red, white and yellow stand for passion, self-sacrifice and spiritual zeal.
Zarok embodies authority at its best, power granted by consent after tests of worth rather than seized.
Zarok is patron of the ninth lunar month and of the Philodox, and favours the Silver Fangs above other tribes for their long tradition of leadership.
Zarok's realm is all air in coloured bands that each turn at their own speed, so visitors must fly and attune to one band at a time.
